met_rainfall_daily.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Met Éireann; data has been modified: filtered to the study period)
met_rainfall_daily.title: Daily rainfall, Cork Airport (Met Éireann climate archive)
met_rainfall_daily.notes: Precipitation amount (mm), 00-24 UTC. Filtered from 2015-01-01. Blank values kept as null. Indicator codes: https://www.met.ie/cms/assets/uploads/2018/05/KeyDly_Rain.txt

met_rainfall_hourly.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Met Éireann; data has been modified: filtered to the study period)
met_rainfall_hourly.title: Hourly rainfall, Cork Airport (Met Éireann climate archive)
met_rainfall_hourly.notes: Hourly precipitation (mm), UTC. Filtered from 2023-01-01. Indicator codes: https://www.met.ie/cms/assets/uploads/2018/05/KeyHourly.txt

met_rainfall_recent.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Met Éireann; data has been modified: filtered to the study period)
met_rainfall_recent.title: Latest hourly reports, Cork Airport (Met Éireann)
met_rainfall_recent.notes: Snapshots of the yesterday/today latest-report feed, appended on every acquisition run. Report times are Irish local time converted to UTC. These are provisional, unquality-controlled reports; the climate archive supersedes them when available. Gaps between the archive end and the first snapshot are left as gaps.

epa_bathing_locations.title: Identified bathing waters in the study area
epa_bathing_locations.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland bathing water open data)
epa_bathing_locations.crs: EPSG:4326 (converted from Irish Grid EPSG:29903; verified against known beach positions)
epa_bathing_locations.notes: Annual classification is the official multi-year EU Bathing Water Directive assessment.

epa_bathing_measurements.title: Bathing water bacteriological results (E. coli, intestinal enterococci)
epa_bathing_measurements.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland bathing water open data)
epa_bathing_measurements.notes: Sampled during the bathing season only (typically June-mid September), so results are seasonal, not continuous. Censored values (e.g. '<10') keep their qualifier. Unit recorded as count/100 ml because the API does not state cfu vs MPN.

epa_bathing_alerts.title: Active bathing water alerts / incidents (national)
epa_bathing_alerts.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland bathing water open data)
epa_bathing_alerts.notes: Only currently active alerts are published by the API. Zero records means no active alert at retrieval time, not a statement that water is safe.

opw_water_levels.title: OPW hydrometric stations: latest water level and temperature (snapshot)
opw_water_levels.licence: Not verified by RunoffPulse: review the waterlevel.ie disclaimer/terms before redistribution. Attribution: Office of Public Works (OPW)
opw_water_levels.notes: Provisional real-time data, not quality-controlled. The API also serves this feed live (cached); this file is the fallback snapshot. Logger voltage (sensor 0003) excluded.

epa_catchment.title: WFD Catchment 19: Lee, Cork Harbour and Youghal Bay
epa_catchment.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_catchment.notes: Official EPA WFD catchment polygon used to define the study area and catchment membership. Geometry simplified (~10-15 m tolerance) for web display.

epa_subcatchments.title: WFD sub-catchments within Catchment 19
epa_subcatchments.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_subcatchments.notes: Official EPA WFD sub-catchment polygons. Geometry simplified for web display.

epa_monitoring_stations.title: EPA water monitoring station locations (Cork Harbour / River Lee study area)
epa_monitoring_stations.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_monitoring_stations.notes: Station locations and attributes only. A station location does not imply a measured result or pollution. Server-side BBOX filter, then local validation: MultiPoint geometries normalised to Point, duplicate StationIDs and invalid coordinates rejected. in_study_catchment is a point-in-polygon test against WFD Catchment 19. Rejections: {'outside study area': 98}.

epa_waterbodies.title: WFD transitional and coastal waterbodies with latest WFD status
epa_waterbodies.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_waterbodies.notes: Official WFD (Cycle 3) waterbody polygons joined by EU code to the EPA latest-status layers (TWB/CWB_WFD_LatestStatus). WFD status is a multi-year ecological assessment, not a current measurement. AdjacentHydrometricArea is the EPA attribute used for catchment-to-waterbody linkage.

epa_rivers.title: WFD river waterbodies in Catchment 19 with latest WFD status
epa_rivers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_rivers.notes: River waterbody lines intersecting the WFD catchment polygon (20 m buffer). Status is the official multi-year WFD ecological status, not a current measurement.

epa_shellfish_waters.title: Designated Shellfish Waters (WFD Register of Protected Areas)
epa_shellfish_waters.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_shellfish_waters.notes: Designated shellfish-water protected areas. These are NOT the SFPA classified bivalve production areas and carry no harvesting classification, biotoxin or closure status. Catchment linkage uses the parent waterbody's EPA AdjacentHydrometricArea attribute.

epa_pressures.title: WFD significant pressures on waterbodies (agriculture, urban waste water, urban run-off)
epa_pressures.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_pressures.crs: n/a (attribute table; geometry used only for catchment intersection)
epa_pressures.notes: WFD Cycle 3 significant-pressure designations. Context only: a designated pressure is not evidence that a specific event was caused by that pressure.

epa_bathing_training_samples.title: Bathing water results within 60 km of Cork Airport (ML training set)
epa_bathing_training_samples.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland bathing water open data)
epa_bathing_training_samples.notes: Used only to train and evaluate the bathing-water ML model (scripts/train_bathing_model.py). Beaches within 60 km of the Met Éireann Cork Airport gauge so that one rain gauge is broadly representative.

epa_screened_catchments.title: WFD catchments connected for screening (Blackwater, Lee, Bandon-Ilen)
epa_screened_catchments.licence: CC BY 4.0 (EPA Ireland open data; attribution: Environmental Protection Agency)
epa_screened_catchments.notes: Official EPA catchment polygons used to assign OPW river gauges to the catchment that feeds each coastal area. Simplified (~100 m) because they are used for gauge assignment, not display.
